title: Ритмы времени / Aja rütmid / Rhythms of Time
license: no licence notice; ETV/ERR archive, all rights reserved implied
notes: Russian-language ETV science film made in Soviet Estonia: a male announcer over photographs of children, an Academy of Sciences presidium, gears and ball-bearings taken from a heap, the Narva power station, and the long window — numbers on a tableau, punched tape running through a reader, a control desk and a calculating machine — then the Tartu University computing centre.
